content_sections.heading: CIPET Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CIPET Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CIPET Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CIPET Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available - 1 for Lecturer (Plastics Engineering & Technology), 1 for Lecturer (Mechanical), 1 for Lecturer (Chemistry), 1 for Lecturer (Electronics), 1 for Lecturer (Physics) and 2 for Instructor (Skill Development).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CIPET to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CIPET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the CIPET Lecturer/Instructor posts is 28 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Lecturer / Instructor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced by CIPET for the Lecturer / Instructor positions in various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CIPET Lecturer / Instructor recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Lecturer posts ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month, depending on the specific discipline and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Instructor (Skill Development) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Instructor (Skill Development) post is between Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CIPET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where is CIPET located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for CIPET located in Balasore, Odisha.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Lecturer / Instructor at CIPET are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for CIPET Recruitment 2026 must be submitted only through the online mode. Offline applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly.
